calculate_bmi.description: Calculate body mass index from a weight in kilograms and a height in metres, and get the health category the result falls in: Underweight, Normal weight, Overweight, or Obese. No API key required.
calculate_bmi.display_str_template: Calculate BMI for {0} kg at {1} m.
calculate_bmi.name: calculate_bmi

parameters.description: Body weight in kilograms, for example 87.9.
parameters.name: weight

parameters.description: Height in metres, for example 1.75. This is metres, not centimetres, so divide a height in centimetres by 100.
parameters.name: height

bmi.description: The calculated body mass index, trimmed to three decimal places.

category.description: The health category for the BMI: Underweight (below 18.5), Normal weight (18.5–24.9), Overweight (25–29.9), or Obese (30 and above).

height.description: The height, in metres, the BMI was calculated from.

weight.description: The weight, in kilograms, the BMI was calculated from.

description: Calculate body mass index from a weight in kilograms and a height in metres, and get the health category it falls in: Underweight, Normal weight, Overweight, or Obese. No account or API key required.
